# Minimized regression fixture from the reported nested-f-string generator pattern.
BASE_OUTPUT_DIR = '/synthetic/node/output'
MODEL_FACTORY_CONTENT = f'''
import uuid
TIME_LIMIT_PER_FOLD = 360
RANDOM_SEED = 42
AUTOGLUON_MODEL_BASE_PATH = "{BASE_OUTPUT_DIR}"
class AutoGluonModel:
    def fit(self, X, y):
        unique_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.path = f"AutogluonModels_{unique_id}"
        self.predictor.fit(X, presets='extreme', seed=RANDOM_SEED)
    def predict(self, X):
        return self.predictor.predict(X)
def build_model(X_train, y_train):
    return AutoGluonModel()
'''
def generate_model_factory_script():
    raise RuntimeError('The outer generator must not execute during normalization')
if __name__ == '__main__':
    generate_model_factory_script()
